'''Wyoming Interstate Gas Pipeline''' is an operational natural gas pipeline.<ref name="source1">[http://bit.ly/2sYXPRn Wyoming Interstate Gas Pipeline,] A Barrel Full, accessed August 2023</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from western Wyoming to Northeast Colorado.

==Background==
Wyoming Interstate Gas Pipeline is owned by Kinder Morgan. The system is comprised of a main system that extends from western Wyoming to northeast Colorado, as well as several pipeline systems that extend from connections along the Wyoming Interstate Gas Pipeline mainline into western Colorado, northeast Wyoming, and eastern Utah.<ref name="source1" /><ref name="source1">[http://bit.ly/2sYXPRn Wyoming Interstate Gas Pipeline,] A Barrel Full, accessed September 2017</ref>
